me-59VX.title: Landscape: pine forests, mostly east
me-59VX.summary: Pine forests in the north and just north of Nikšić, but most common in the east.

me-62xq.title: Google car: short antenna by coast, long inland
me-62xq.summary: Rifts (stitching cracks) are common on Gen 3 inland, where the car has a long antenna. On the coast the car has a short antenna and almost never rifts, except near Utjeha and Dobra Voda.

me-9667.title: Landscape: staircase-like mountainsides
me-9667.summary: Mountainsides that look like steps, seen in the Cemi River valley.

me-9laJ.title: Landscape: small, mountainous, narrow roads
me-9laJ.summary: Inland mountains are lush and green, while coastal mountains show bare, light-coloured rock. Most roads are only one or two lanes wide.

me-BFX1.title: Landscape: grassy treeless high mountains
me-BFX1.summary: A national park with grassy, treeless mountains and a high-altitude feel. The town inside it has unusual architecture.

me-CFIQ.title: Bollard: stone posts beside a railway bridge
me-CFIQ.summary: The Skadar Lake bridge has a railway next to the road and stone bollards along it.

me-ESKL.title: Chevron: black on white or red on yellow
me-ESKL.summary: Chevron signs are black on white, or red on yellow. Albania uses white on black instead.

differs.how: Albanian chevrons are white on black

me-Ifx0.title: Landscape: lake with many small islands
me-Ifx0.summary: A lake dotted with many small islands (Slansko Lake).

me-MYa5.title: Bollard: black top, red reflector front
me-MYa5.summary: White post with a black top, a red reflector on the front and a white one on the back. Slovenia uses the same bollard.

me-RPvd.title: Guardrail: both A-type and B-type
me-RPvd.summary: The only Balkan country where you commonly see both A-type and B-type guardrails, two different rail profiles, side by side.

me-VuAe.title: Landmark: coal mine with gravel wall
me-VuAe.summary: A coal mine recognisable by a wide, artificial wall of gravel, often visible from far away.

me-YLJY.title: Landscape: dry treeless mountains, vineyards
me-YLJY.summary: Around the capital and south of it: dry, treeless mountains, with vineyards common.

me-arxV.title: Landscape: touristy bay, swimwear, steep ridge
me-arxV.summary: A busy, touristy bay with many people in swimwear and a steep rocky ridge above it.

me-cJhu.title: City: modern buildings, wide roads
me-cJhu.summary: The capital and biggest city looks modern, with new buildings, wide roads and modern infrastructure.

me-gPE6.title: Pole: simple round concrete or wood
me-gPE6.summary: Plain round concrete poles, or wooden ones.

me-gh0p.title: Google car: 'rifts' (stitching cracks), uncommon
me-gh0p.summary: Rifts are visible seams or cracks in the picture caused by poor stitching. They show up now and then in Gen 3 coverage. Albania has them often.

differs.how: Rifts are common in Albania, only occasional here

me-ioMs.title: Google car: low Gen 4 'smallcam'
me-ioMs.summary: Gen 4 camera mounted lower than usual, with a big round blur and a small bump at the front. The blur can be fully see-through. Much of the Balkans and southern Europe has this.

me-lm-23781.title: Sign: thin numbers on speed signs
me-lm-23781.summary: Numbers on speed limit signs are written in a thin font. Albania's are much thicker.

differs.how: Albanian speed sign numbers are much thicker

me-lm-787128.title: Language: Latin letters with Ś and Ź
me-lm-787128.summary: A South Slavic language, nearly identical to Serbian. Mostly Latin script on signs. The letters Ś and Ź do not exist in Croatian, Bosnian or Serbian. Street is 'ulica'.

me-vHGt.title: Landscape: green farm valleys, cleared hills
me-vHGt.summary: In the north: green farming valleys with hills cleared of trees to make farmland.

me-y5eW.title: Plate: EU plate, coat of arms on red circle
me-y5eW.summary: Standard European plate with a blue strip, but the coat of arms sits on a red circle that shows through the blur. Albanian plates have no red circle.

differs.how: Albanian plates have no red circle on the white part
